contexts.text: Broidered work from Egypt () = scientifics, and thus rituals representative of spiritual things. AC 2576:8.
Broidered work, etc. () = Knowledges of good.
Fine linen of broidered work () = the truths of knowledges, which are of service.
The work of the embroiderer ().
The truths of the Ancient Church are described by garments of broidered work, etc. (). By broidered work are signified scientific truths.
Fine linen in broidered work from Egypt, which was its expansion = truth from scientifics, as a sign or external significative of that Church.
Jerusalem's garments of fine linen, silk, and broidered work () = truths in the Rational and in each Natural.
Broidered work () = the Scientific: when this is genuine, in the other life it appears as broidered work, and as lace.
In , it treats of Tyre, by which are represented the Knowledges of truth and good, which, when genuine, are fine linen in broidered work from Egypt.
She shall be brought to the king in things embroidered ()... Things embroidered = the lowest truths.
A great eagle... which had broidered work ()... Broidered work = what is scientific. AC 9688:6.
Broidered work from Egypt = the Scientific of truth.

The work of the embroiderer () = the things which are of the Scientific. (9766) The work of the embroiderer, or embroidery = the Scientific. In many places in the Word what is embroidered, and embroidery are mentioned, and they everywhere = what is scientific. The cause of this is from the representatives in the other life. There appear there garments embroidered in various ways, by which are signified scientific truths. Scientific truths differ from intellectual truths as external things from internal ones, or as the Natural from the Spiritual... for the Intellectual is the Visual of the internal man, and scientifics are its objects in the external man: the latter are signified by the work of the embroiderer; the former, by the work of the contriver; for to contrive is the work of the understanding; and to embroider is that of one who is knowing and efficient from the understanding. Hence it is, that those things in the Habitation which signified internal things, were of the work of the contriver... but those which signified external things, were of the work of the embroiderer; as the covering for the door of the Tent, and for the gate of the court; and also the belt...

That embroidery, and what is embroidered = the Scientific which is of the external or natural man. Illustrated... Fine linen in broidered work = scientifictruth; forfine linen = truth from a celestial origin; and broidered work = what is scientific: therefore it is also said from Egypt, because Egypt = what is scientific...
Garments of broidered work () = scientific truths, which also are external ones. AC 9825:2.
Garments of broidered work () = scientific truths. AC 10540:2. AE 195:7.
What is embroidered () = the Scientific of truth.
What is embroidered () = the scientific which is of the natural man.
The Voluntary, the Intellectual, and the Scientific... are signified in the Word by the weaver, the contriver, and the embroiderer.

As by the garments of Aaron was represented the Spiritual Heaven adjoined to the Celestial Kingdom... therefore in connection with the garments there is mentioned the work of the embroiderer, of the contriver, and of the weaver; and thereby are signified the things which are from the Scientific, from the Intellectual, and from the Voluntary; or, what is the same, from the Natural, from the Spiritual, and from the Celestial.

(The belt) thou shalt make with the work of the embroiderer  = the Knowledges of good and truth. The work of the embroiderer = that which is from scientifics. The reason it is said, by means of the Knowledges of good and truth, is that by these are meant interior scientifics, such as are those of the Church concerning faith and lobe. The reason these scientifics are meant by the work of the embroiderer, is that by the belt of the coat, which was of the work of the embroiderer, is signified the inmost bond of the Spiritual Kingdom; and all things in the Spiritual World are held together in connection by means of Knowledges, and the affections thence derived.
From her application, which is to such things as are works of the hands, and are called knitting, embroidery... of service for adornment...
There came maidens, with works of embroidery and knitting, the work of their own hands.
See Educate.
The things embroidered in which she shall be brought to the king = the Knowledges of truth.
What is embroidered = the Scientific which is of the natural man.
Embroidery = what is scientific. AE 654:31.
Embroidery = what is scientific and cognitive.
Garments of broidered work = the Knowledges of truth from the Word. AE 395:9.
To clothe with broidered work, and to shoe with badger () = to instruct in the Knowledges of good and truth from the sense of the letter of the Word. AE 1143:2.
Embroidery from Egypt = the knowledge of such things as are of the Church.
What is embroidered = truth from a natural origin, which is called scientific.
She shall be brought to the king in things embroidered = the appearances of truth, such as are in the letter of the Word.
The knowledges of good and truth are signified by embroidery from Egypt.
